sentences.text: Edna Hollis (S2) was present for the meeting with Social Worker Priya Nandra (S1).
The assessment is a review following Edna's fall in October to evaluate how carers are working.
Edna Hollis (S2) reported that her hip is stiff in the mornings.
Edna Hollis (S2) uses a frame in the house.
Edna Hollis (S2) does not go out without someone.
Edna Hollis (S2) receives morning and teatime care from a carer named Jade, who does her tablets and helps her wash.
Edna Hollis (S2) describes the teatime carer as being 'in and out' quickly sometimes.
Edna Hollis (S2) eats toast for dinner at the end of the month because there is no money left.
Edna Hollis (S2) does not turn on the heating during the day, only when someone is coming.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated she does not want Kyle in trouble or the police involved.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated she does not want the police involved.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated she does not want Kyle arrested.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated Kyle has not threatened or hurt her.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated she does not know if Kyle gambles, as her daughter Sandra claims it is where the money goes.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated she does not receive Attendance Allowance, only her pension.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated her grandson Kyle (23) visits most weeks and helps by bringing her paper and using the cash machine for her.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated Kyle uses her bank card and takes £50 out every week for himself.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated Kyle never asked for the £50; she only sees it on the statement.
Edna Hollis (S2) reported that £400 from her purse for Christmas presents was taken by Kyle three weeks ago (Sunday).
Edna Hollis (S2) stated Kyle has not yet paid back the £400, but said he would.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated her daughter Sandra knows about the £400 being taken but not about the bank card.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated she does not want the carers (Jade and the teatime caller) in trouble.
Edna Hollis (S2) agreed to ring the bank with the social worker to stop the card and get a new one.
Edna Hollis (S2) agreed that online shopping could be delivered so nobody needs her card.
Edna Hollis (S2) agreed to ring the social worker if Kyle asks for money before Thursday and she is worried.
The social worker (S1) agreed to log a safeguarding concern today.
The social worker (S1) agreed to return on Thursday the 26th at 10:00 to ring the bank together and bring the Attendance Allowance form.
The social worker (S1) agreed to ring Sandra this week about online shopping.
The social worker (S1) agreed to mention the rushed teatime calls to the agency.
